name: Harry Gregg
bio: Harry Gregg of Spearfish, a former superintendent of the Homestake mine, was a Lawrence County legislator who passed through Medora in January 1885 and promised to work for repeal of the herd law. When the fence law passed in March 1885, the paper credited him and the other Black Hills members.

moments.label: Credited with passing the fence law
